g.title: HQC128DecoderFlow
g.text: code_decode(): Reed-Muller duplicated RM(1,7) -> shortened Reed-Solomon RS-S1 over GF(2^8)

g.title: input
g.text: From HQC decrypt: v XOR Truncate(u*y)

g.title: layout
g.text: bit t = 32*part + bit, from u32[part] >> bit

g.title: rm_out
g.text: A noisy RS-S1 codeword over GF(2^8)

g.title: rs_in
g.text: Can correct up to 15 symbol errors
